blocks.prompt:
1 Define biotechnology and genetic engineering. (i) How does modern biotechnology differ from traditional biotechnology? (ii) Name and explain the two basic technologies of genetic engineering. (4 marks)
(Biotechnology aur genetic engineering ki definition likhein. (i) Jadeed biotechnology riwayati se kaise mukhtalif hai? (ii) Genetic engineering ki do buniyadi technologies ke naam likh kar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Biotechnology: organisms, biological processes ya systems ka istemal taa ke aise products banein jo insani zindagi aur mahol behtar karein; is ki tawajjo medicine, zaraat aur industry ke masail par hai.
Genetic engineering: organism ke DNA mein tabdeeli taa ke us ke traits ya salahiyatein badlein, genes daal kar, nikaal kar ya badal kar aur kabhi species ke darmiyan genes muntaqil kar ke. Yeh jadeed biotechnology ka asal 'engine' hai.

(i) Riwayati biotechnology hazaron saal se fermentation ki shakal mein bread, cheese aur beer banane ke liye istemal hoti rahi. Jadeed biotechnology 20vi sadi mein DNA ki structure aur advanced molecular techniques ki daryaft ke baad aayi.

(ii) 1. Recombinant DNA technology: aik organism ke DNA ka tukra kaat kar doosre ke DNA mein jodna.
2. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR): DNA ke chhote tukre ko tezi se bari miqdar mein barhana.

book_ref.quote: the true "engine" of modern biotechnology is

blocks.prompt:
2 What are vectors? Describe the different types of vectors used in recombinant DNA technology. (4 marks)
(Vectors kya hain? Recombinant DNA technology mein istemal hone wale vectors ki iqsaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Vectors (molecular carriers) khaas molecules hain jo gene of interest ko host cells mein dakhil karte hain. Gene of interest vector se joda jata hai aur vector recombinant DNA (rDNA) ban jata hai; phir rDNA host cells mein dala jata hai.

Iqsaam:
1. Bacteria ke plasmids: sab se zyada istemal hone wale vectors.
2. Bacteriophages, maslan phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1.
3. Cosmids: woh plasmids jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka chhota hissa, cos sequence, ho.
4. Bacterial artificial chromosomes (BACs).
5. Yeast artificial chromosomes (YACs).
6. P1 artificial chromosomes: P1 vectors aur BACs dono ki khususiyaat.
7. Animal viruses, maslan human cold virus, genes ko bandar aur insani cells mein le jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The gene of interest is attached to the vector and the vectors becomes a recombinant DNA (rDNA).

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain restriction sites and the formation of sticky ends. (i) What makes a restriction site palindromic? (ii) How do sticky ends allow the gene of interest and the vector to be joined? (4 marks)
(Restriction sites aur sticky ends ka banna samjhayein. (i) Restriction site palindromic kyun hoti hai? (ii) Sticky ends gene of interest aur vector ko jodne mein kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Har restriction endonuclease DNA ki aik makhsoos nucleotide sequence, restriction site ya recognition region, pehchanta hai; wahan jud kar site ke andar aik khaas jagah se DNA kaat'ta hai.

(i) Restriction sites ki palindromic sequences chaar se aath nucleotides ki hoti hain: aik sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke complementary hote hain, is liye dono strands ki sequence aik jaisi magar mukhalif simton mein chalti hai. Enzyme dono strands ko kaat'ta hai.

(ii) Kaatne ke baad dono tukron ke chand nucleotides lambe single-stranded sticky sire hote hain jo aapas mein complementary hain. Jab source DNA aur vector aik hi restriction endonuclease se kaate jayein to gene of interest aur kate vector par milte julte sticky ends bante hain, is liye aik hi enzyme ke koi bhi do tukre jud sakte hain. Kata vector aur gene DNA ligase (molecular glue) ke saath rakhe jaate hain jo saath wale nucleotides mein phosphodiester linkages bana kar recombinant vector banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The enzyme binds to the DNA at that sequence, and cuts the DNA at a particular place within this site.

blocks.prompt:
4 Answer about the expression system. (i) What is an expression system? (ii) Describe how the recombinant vector is cloned in an expression system. (4 marks)
(Expression system ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) Expression system kya hai? (ii) Bayan karein ke recombinant vector expression system mein kaise clone hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Expression system: woh munasib organism jo rDNA (vector se juda gene of interest) ka host bane aur gene of interest ko express kare. Is ka intikhab rDNA banane wale vector ki qisam par munhasir hai. Bacterial cells apni short generation time aur saada genetic system ki wajah se behtareen expression system hain.

(ii) Recombinant vector ki cloning:
1. Recombinant DNA (vector) aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein rakhe jaate hain.
2. Bacterial cells recombinant DNA le lete hain.
3. Yeh bacteria barh kar aise clones banate hain jin mein gene of interest ki aik jaisi copies hoti hain.
4. Phir clone library ki screening se woh clones pehchane jaate hain jin mein waqai recombinant plasmid hai.

book_ref.quote: Bacterial cells act as an ideal expression system

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: medium mein rakhe gaye sab bacteria plasmid nahi lete. Isi liye agla qadam screening hai, jo batata hai ke kis bacteria ne waqai recombinant plasmid liya.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the three methods used for screening of a clone library. (4 marks)
(Clone library ki screening ke teen tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Vectors host cells mein daalne ke baad scientists pehchante hain ke kin bacteria ne waqai recombinant plasmid liya:

1. Vector ka intikhab (antibiotic resistance): plasmid mein antibiotic resistance gene hota hai. Bacteria us antibiotic (maslan ampicillin) wale medium par ugaye jaate hain; sirf plasmid lene wale cells zinda reh kar barhte hain.

2. Gene of interest ka intikhab (blue-white screening): plasmid ka lacZ' gene aisa enzyme banata hai jo khaas sugar ko metabolize kar ke neela kar deta hai. Agar plasmid recombinant nahi to lacZ' kaam karta hai aur colony neeli hoti hai. Agar gene of interest dakhil hua to lacZ' toot jata hai aur matloob recombinant clones safaid rehte hain.

3. Khaas gene ki pehchan (DNA hybridization): radioactive probe, yani gene of interest ka complementary DNA strand, sirf us gene wali colonies se chipakta hai. Autoradiography (photographic film) in colonies ko master plate par dhoondti hai.

book_ref.quote: scientists identify which bacteria actually took up the recombinant plasmid

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain how the temperature is changed in the steps of PCR, and give the role of the primers, Taq polymerase and nucleotides. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke PCR ke qadamon mein temperature kaise badla jata hai, aur primers, Taq polymerase aur nucleotides ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qadamon mein temperature:
1. Denaturation (taqreeban 98°C): zyada primer aur DNA tukre ka mixture garam hota hai; double-stranded DNA single strands mein toot'ta hai, har aik in vitro DNA synthesis ka template.
2. Annealing (taqreeban 60°C): thanda hone par forward aur backward primers single strands ke complementary hisson se jurte hain; baqi hissa single-stranded rehta hai.
3. Extension (behtareen 72°C, taqreeban aik minute): primers barh kar poori complementary copies bante hain.
4. Dohrana: qadam 1 se 3 dohraye jaate hain; har cycle aik ya do minute leta hai.

Ajza ka kirdar:
1. Primers (20 se 30 nucleotides, zyada miqdar mein): complementary hisson se jud kar copy shuru karne ki jagah dete hain.
2. Taq polymerase: garam chashmon ke Thermus aquaticus ka garmi bardasht enzyme; primer ke 3' sire par naye nucleotides jodta hai. Garmi ise nuqsan nahi deti, is liye dobara dalna nahi parta.
3. Nucleotides (chaaron qisam): naye complementary strands ki eentein.

book_ref.quote: First, an excessive amount of primer (a sequence of 20 to 30 nucleotides) is mixed with the DNA fragment

blocks.prompt:
7 Answer about PCR. (i) How does the number of DNA copies increase in PCR? (ii) Describe the applications of PCR. (4 marks)
(PCR ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) PCR mein DNA copies ki tadaad kaise barhti hai? (ii) PCR ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Har cycle mein dono strands replicate hote hain, is liye aik tukre se do copies; qadam 1 se 3 dohrane par do se chaar, phir aath, aur isi tarah. Har cycle aik ya do minute leta aur DNA molecules dugne karta hai. 20 cycles ke baad aik tukre se das lakh se zyada copies banti hain. Garmi Taq polymerase ko nuqsan nahi deti, is liye mazeed polymerase nahi dala jata.

(ii) Istemal:
1. Infectious agents ke genotypes pehchanne ki mo'assar tashkhees technique.
2. Kuch genetic bimariyon aur cancers ki zimmedar mutations ki pehchan.
3. Jurm ki tehqeeq: sookhe khoon ke chhote namoone ya aik baal ki jar ke cells se DNA fingerprints.
4. Chand jhare hue cells ka DNA barha kar bohat ibtidai embryos mein genetic naqais dhoondna.
5. Khatam shuda species ka DNA jaanchna, jab tak us ki bohat thodi miqdar bhi saalim ho.
6. Genomic library (aik organism ka kul DNA) banana, jo DNA sequencing mein kaam aati hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used to detect genetic mutations responsible for certain genetic diseases and cancers.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the common techniques used to transfer the gene of interest into a target cell. (4 marks)
(Gene of interest ko target cell mein muntaqil karne ki aam techniques bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gene (DNA) cell tabah kiye baghair cell membrane ya cell wall ke raaste target cell mein jata hai; poore multicellular GMO ke liye gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein, phir aise gametes milaye jaate hain.

1. Electroporation: target cell ki cell wall ya cell membrane mein suraakh bante hain; gene andar jata hai aur bijli ka current khatam hote hi suraakh band ho jaate hain.
2. Microinjection: bareek sui (injection) se gene seedha target cell ke nucleus mein.
3. Biolistic transformation: gene heavy metal (aam taur par gold ya tungsten) ke khurdbeeni zarron par chadha kar gene gun ki mechanical quwwat se cell mein maara jata hai.
4. Protoplast mediated technique: cell wall hata kar protoplast (cell membrane saalim) banta hai, jise gene wale medium mein milaya jata hai; DNA membrane se andar jata hai.
5. Chemical methods: naked DNA chemical agent se milaya jata hai; complex diffusion ya endocytosis se cytoplasm mein jata hai.
6. Virus mediated gene transfer: adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene le jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The following are common techniques used to transfer the gene of interest into a target cell.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define GMO and transgenic organism. Describe the uses of transgenic bacteria. (4 marks)
(GMO aur transgenic organism ki definition likhein. Transgenic bacteria ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
GMO: paudha, janwar ya microbe jis ka genome badla gaya ho. Transgenic organisms GMOs ka makhsoos hissa hain jinhein kisi doosri, ghair-mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho.

Transgenic bacteria: mukhtalif organisms ke genes plasmid mein jod kar bacteria mein dale jaate hain jo phir un genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain. Istemal:
1. Dawaiyan, maslan insulin (diabetes), human growth hormone (bonapan), interferon (kuch cancers) aur tissue plasminogen activator (khoon ke lothre ghulana).
2. Khane ki ashya: alpha-amylase (starch se saada sugars), chymosin (cheese ke liye doodh ka protein jamana) aur pectin-esterase (juice saaf karna).
3. Toxins torne wale enzymes jo pollutants ko kam zehreela banate hain.
4. Ore se copper nikaalna, mercury ki aaloodgi saaf karna aur peene ke paani mein arsenic dhoondna.

book_ref.quote: Different forms of transgenic bacteria are being used to;

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a transgenic animal? Describe the examples of transgenic animals given in the chapter. (4 marks)
(Transgenic animal kya hai? Chapter mein di gayi transgenic animals ki misalein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transgenic animal mein ghair gene hota hai jo matloob protein banata hai. Yeh dawaiyan banane, paidawar barhane aur bimari se mazbooti ke liye istemal hote hain.

1. Transgenic doodh wali gayon mein insani genes hain aur woh insani maa ke doodh jaisa doodh deti hain.
2. Transgenic bakriyan mazboot makri ke jale jaise silk proteins wala doodh deti hain.
3. Transgenic bakriyan doodh mein insani enzyme lysozyme banati hain jo insanon mein dast wale bacteria se larta hai.
4. Transgenic bakri se pehli insani biological dawa anticoagulant thi jo surgery ya wiladat mein khoon jamne ka imkaan kam kare.
5. Transgenic machhli mein behtar growth, kam khurak, zyada sardi bardasht aur bimari se mazbooti.
6. Malaria se mehfooz machharon mein aisa gene jo Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam kare.
7. Transgenic choohe (1980s ke wast se) bimariyon ki tehqeeq ka ahem model hain, kyunke un ka genome mukammal parha ja chuka aur insanon jaisa hai.
8. Gene therapy mein genetically modified viruses insanon tak genes pahunchate hain taa ke T aur B cells ki ghair-maamooli nashonuma aur wirasati andhapan jaisi bimariyon ka ilaj ho.

book_ref.quote: Transgenic animals serve various purposes e.g., producing drugs, enhancing yields

blocks.prompt:
11 How are transgenic plants produced? Describe the main purposes of producing transgenic plants. (4 marks)
(Transgenic paude kaise banaye jaate hain? Transgenic paude banane ke asal maqasid bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tayyari: bohat se plant cells totipotent hain, yani aik cell naya paudha bana sakta hai, is liye biologists aik transgenic plant cell se poora naya paudha ugaate hain.

Asal maqasid:
1. Keeron se mazbooti: mitti ke bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis ke genes cotton, rice, maize, potato, tomato, brinjal, cauliflower, cabbage waghera mein dale gaye; yeh aise proteins banate hain jo nuqsandeh keeron ko maarte magar mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahi dete.
2. Herbicide se mazbooti: bohat si faslein glyphosate (herbicide) ke khilaf mazboot hain.
3. Behtar ghiza: transgenic rice mein iron barhane ke liye beans, Aspergillus fungus aur wild rice ke genes, aur beta-carotene (vitamin A ka pehla madda) ke liye daffodil ke genes. Yeh wahan ugaya jata hai jahan iron aur vitamin A kam hai; har saal iron ki kami 1.4 billion auraton ko mutasir karti, aur vitamin A ki kami 670,000 bachon ki jaan leti aur 500,000 bachon mein na-qabil-e-ilaj andhapan laati hai.
4. Biopharmaceuticals: GMO paude aur plant cells cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The main purposes of producing transgenic plants are;

blocks.prompt:
12 Compare the uses of transgenic bacteria and transgenic plants. (4 marks)
(Transgenic bacteria aur transgenic paudon ke istemal ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein ghair genes hain; bacteria zyada tar protein ki factory hain, jabke paude behtar faslein hain aur biopharmaceuticals bhi banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Biologists grow a new plant from a transgenic cell of plant.

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the role of genetic engineering in medicine, using examples from bacteria, animals, plants and gene therapy. (4 marks)
(Bacteria, janwaron, paudon aur gene therapy ki misalon se medicine mein genetic engineering ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Transgenic bacteria: bari miqdar mein dawaiyan banate hain, jaise diabetes ke liye human insulin (genetic engineers ki pehli bari kamyabi), bonapan ke liye human growth hormone, kuch cancers ke liye interferon aur khoon ke lothre ghulane ke liye tissue plasminogen activator.
2. Transgenic janwar: bakriyan anticoagulant (transgenic bakri se pehli insani biological dawa) banati hain jo surgery ya wiladat mein khoon jamna kam kare, aur doodh mein dast wale bacteria ke khilaf lysozyme; transgenic choohe bimariyon ki tehqeeq ke model hain; malaria se mehfooz machhar Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam karte hain.
3. Transgenic paude: GMO paude aur plant cells cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines banate hain; zyada iron aur beta-carotene wala rice iron aur vitamin A ki kami se larta hai.
4. Gene therapy: genetically modified viruses wirasati bimariyon, jaise T aur B cells ki ghair-maamooli nashonuma aur wirasati andhapan, ke ilaj ke liye genes pahunchate hain. Zyada tehqeeq somatic cells par hai kyunke germline tabdeeli wirasat mein jati aur khatraat aur akhlaqi masail rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: GMO plants and plant cells are used for the production of biopharmaceuticals

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the five steps of making human insulin in bacteria. (4 marks)
(Bacteria mein human insulin banane ke paanch qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Human insulin, jo pancreas ki insulin jaisi hai, us ki do polypeptide chains alag bana kar aur kimiyai taur par jod kar banti hai.

1. Do genes ki tayyari: insulin ki do alag chains hain, is liye do DNA sequences banti hain, aik chain A aur aik chain B ke liye.
2. Recombinant plasmids ki tameer: plasmids ke do sets liye jaate hain; chain A ka DNA aik set mein aur chain B ka doosre mein. Insulin gene aksar lacZ jaise bacterial gene ke saath joda jata hai taa ke bacteria ghair DNA pehchan kar express karein.
3. Host cells ki transformation: recombinant plasmids Escherichia coli ki do alag cultures mein dale jaate hain; culture 1 chain A ki factory aur culture 2 chain B ki.
4. Fermentation aur protein expression: bacteria bare industrial bioreactors mein ugaye jaate hain; barhte hue woh insani DNA parh kar insulin chains bari miqdar mein banate hain.
5. Nikalna aur kimiyai jor: bacteria jama kar ke chains nikaali aur saaf ki jati hain; chain A aur B mila kar makhsoos amino acids ke darmiyan disulfide bonds (sulfur-sulfur pul) se jodi jati hain aur fa'al teen-jihati insulin molecule banta hai.

book_ref.quote: This final step creates the functional, three-dimensional human insulin molecule
